## Fold hit feel & selection character count

- **Larger fold column**: gpui-base fold hitbox widened (margin 8px, hitbox 24px, icon 16px) so chevron clicks are less fiddly; Malgel gutter hit-test stays aligned. Folding already worked in 0.1.19 — this is hit *feel*, not a fold-broken fix.
- **Ctrl+Shift+[ / ] e2e**: smoke test folds a Markdown heading and unfolds it again.
- **Status bar selection**: `(N selected)` counts Unicode characters (scalars), not UTF-8 bytes — an en-dash counts as 1.

### Acceptance
- Fold chevron / column easier to hit than the old ~18px squeeze
- Ctrl+Shift+[ collapses a heading section; Ctrl+Shift+] expands it
- Select a line containing `–`; status bar character count matches visible length (not +2 for the dash)
